Polymend

Make problematic 3D models printable. Drop in a GLB or STL and Polymend fixes the small mesh faults that make a slicer complain.

Built for small faults: stray triangles, pinholes and reversed faces. Tested on sculpted figures, CAD parts and 3D scans, in two slicers.
